SELECT 
  AVG(avg_duration) AS avg_of_avg_durations,
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratios
FROM (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_duration,
    AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
)    -- returns [4.9567269020915905, 0.11627726232366875]
